title: lightningpixel/modly
claim: lightningpixel/modly — Desktop app to generate 3D models from images using local AI, running entirely on your GPU.
hook: Turn a photo into a 3D model on your own GPU — local image-to-3D with no cloud and no subscription.
why_good: Image-to-3D is taking off for game assets, 3D printing and AR, but the best pipelines are cloud and metered; modly runs the whole thing locally on your GPU — exactly what studios and makers with cost or privacy constraints want; ~4.7k stars in four months.
value: A paid pro desktop plus pipeline integrations (Blender, Unity, 3D-print slicers) sold to indie game studios, print shops and product designers who generate models in volume.
risk: On-device quality trails the best cloud models, and 3D/AI incumbents and GPU makers are racing into image-to-3D; local has to stay good-enough and meter-free to win.

zh.claim: lightningpixel/modly —— 从图片生成 3D 模型的桌面 app,完全在你本地 GPU 上运行。
zh.hook: 把一张照片变成 3D 模型,全程跑在你自己的 GPU 上——本地图生 3D,不上云、无订阅。
zh.why_good: 图生 3D 正在游戏素材、3D 打印和 AR 里爆发,但好用的管线都在云端且按量计费;modly 把整套流程放到本地 GPU 上跑——正是有成本或隐私顾虑的工作室和创客想要的;四个月约 4.7 千星。
zh.value: 向独立游戏工作室、打印工坊和产品设计师卖付费专业版加管线集成(Blender、Unity、3D 打印切片器)——他们要批量出模型。
zh.risk: 本地质量落后于最强云端模型,3D/AI 大厂和 GPU 厂商都在冲图生 3D;本地版必须一直「够用 + 不计费」才守得住。

pick_reason: A clear creator-tool product — local image-to-3D — with obvious paid desktop and pipeline-integration upsells.
